description: This file is a TypeScript script for static analysis to enforce rules around pairing store identifiers and group authorization logic. It imports TypeScript compiler API and project-specific utility modules to analyze source files and identify violations related to pairing store identifiers in group auth contexts.

methods.name: getDeclarationNameText
methods.description: Extracts the name text from different types of TypeScript node names, including identifiers and binding patterns.

methods.name: containsPairingStoreSource
methods.description: Recursively searches for pairing store identifier usage or specific call expressions within a given AST node.

methods.name: getCallName
methods.description: Retrieves the call expression name from a CallExpression node, handling both identifier and property access expressions.

methods.name: isSuspiciousNormalizeWithStoreCall
methods.description: Detects calls to 'normalizeAllowFromWithStore' with specific object literal patterns indicating pairing store entries.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Traverses the source file's AST and identifies any violations related to pairing store identifiers used in group-scoped variables or properties, or suspicious normalize calls.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that collects violations across files and reports errors if any violations are found.
